title: Sign a Git Hub App assertion
responsibility: Import an RSA app key and sign a short-lived GitHub App JWT.

inputs.name: githubAppKey.pem
inputs.description: PKCS#1 or PKCS#8 PEM, accepting real or escaped newlines.

inputs.name: githubAppJwt.input
inputs.description: App ID, imported signing key and current time in milliseconds.

outputs.name: githubAppKey
outputs.description: Nonextractable RSA SHA-256 signing key; invalid PEM or import failure rejects with github-disabled.

outputs.name: githubAppJwt
outputs.description: RS256 JWT with app ID issuer, issued-at one minute before the supplied time and expiration nine minutes after it.
